summary: In Step 1, I tapped the bottom area of the splash screen marked in red; the screen transitioned to the 'Welcome to Evia' page, but an application error dialog titled 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' immediately appeared over the view. This dialog presents two options: 'Close app' and 'Wait'. Beneath the dialog, the 'Welcome to Evia' screen is visible, displaying the text 'Discover exciting events, join what you love, and earn rewards along the way' along with buttons for 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest'.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Wait' button on the 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' system dialog marked in red. Following this action, the dialog disappeared from the screen, revealing the underlying 'Welcome to Evia!' landing page. The screen now displays the app logo, a mascot illustration, and three primary navigation options: 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest'. The interface appears responsive, and no further error banners or system dialogs are currently visible over the main welcome content.

In Step 3, I tapped the 'Log In' button on the welcome screen; immediately following the interaction, an 'App Not Responding' system dialog appeared over the interface. The dialog is titled 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' and presents two options: 'Close app' and 'Wait'. The underlying welcome screen, which includes the 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest' buttons, remains visible behind the modal alert.

In Step 4, I tapped the 'Close app' button on the 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' dialog box that was overlaying the EVIA welcome screen. Following this action, the application closed, and the display transitioned to the Android home screen, which features a Calendar widget prompting to 'Sign in to view your schedule' and various app icons including Play Store, Google, Gmail, Chrome, YouTube, Photos, and a Flutter icon. The EVIA app interface is no longer visible on the screen.

In Step 5, I launched the 'prm393_lab03' application from the home screen; the display transitioned from the Android home screen, which featured icons for Gmail, Chrome, YouTube, Photos, and a Flutter icon, to the 'evia' application's splash screen. The new screen displays the 'evia' logo in blue and green centered on a plain white background, with no other interface elements or navigation options currently visible.

In Step 6, I tapped the 'Log In' button located at the bottom of the screen; immediately following this action, an 'App isn't responding' system dialog appeared over the 'Welcome to Evia' screen. The dialog displays the text 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' along with 'Close app' and 'Wait' options. The underlying screen remains visible, showing the 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest' buttons, as well as the text 'Discover exciting events, join what you love, and earn rewards along the way'.
